import re
HEAD = re.compile(r"^Interface\s+Admin\s+Link\s+Proto")
SKIP = re.compile(r"^\S+@\S+>|^\{[^}]*\}\s*$")
IFACE = re.compile(r"^(?P<interface>\S+)\s+(?P<admin>up|down)\s+(?P<link>up|down)"
                   r"(?:\s+(?P<proto>[a-z][a-z0-9-]*))?(?:\s+(?P<local>\S*[./:]\S*))?"
                   r"(?:\s+-->\s+(?P<remote>\S+))?\s*$")
CONT = re.compile(r"^\s+(?:(?P<proto>[a-z][a-z0-9-]*)(?=\s|$))?\s*"
                  r"(?:(?P<local>\S*[./:]\S*)(?:\s+-->\s+(?P<remote>\S+))?)?\s*$")
COLS = ["Interface", "Admin", "Link", "Proto", "Local", "Remote"]

def parse(lines):
    recs, used, skip = [], [], []
    cur = None
    for j, ln in enumerate(lines):
        if not ln.strip():
            continue
        if SKIP.search(ln):
            skip.append(j)
            continue
        if HEAD.match(ln):
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = IFACE.match(ln)
        if m:
            g = m.groupdict()
            cur = {"Interface": g["interface"], "Admin": g["admin"], "Link": g["link"]}
            recs.append(dict(cur, Proto=g["proto"] or "", Local=g["local"] or "",
                             Remote=g["remote"] or ""))
            used.append(j)
            continue
        m = CONT.match(ln)
        if m and cur is not None:
            g = m.groupdict()
            proto = g["proto"] or recs[-1]["Proto"]
            recs.append(dict(cur, Proto=proto, Local=g["local"] or "", Remote=g["remote"] or ""))
            used.append(j)
    recs = [{c: r[c] for c in COLS} for r in recs]
    return {"blocks": [{"name": "interfaces", "kind": "table", "lines": used, "records": recs}],
            "skip": skip}
